title: Diamond Lower Body
description: Lower body session with pulse squats and Bulgarian split squats, finished with an intense core block

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-down pulses

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Rear foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Hip thrust (floor)
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift the hips, squeeze the glutes

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.instructions: Lean back, knees forward, quads on fire

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet lifted, rotate the torso side to side

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
